rationale: The obligation asks which of eight Outfall 001 parameters (Flow, dissolved copper, dissolved cadmium, hardness, TSS monthly average, TSS daily maximum, total aluminum, total copper) support numeric exceedance comparison versus report-only monitoring. The evidence packet grounds only a subset. Flow (selected_observations[0], gcc/final_permit.pdf page 3 section part_i: 'Report MGD' in both limit columns) is report-only — per-parameter REJECT for numeric_comparison_applicable. Dissolved copper (selected_observations[1]: 'Report' in the operative limit columns) is report-only — per-parameter REJECT. Total Suspended Solids (selected_observations[2]: monthly-average column 'Report', daily-maximum column '50') is mixed — per-parameter REJECT for TSS monthly average, per-parameter ACCEPT for TSS daily maximum where a numeric limit of 50 is stated. No packet observation addresses dissolved cadmium, hardness, total aluminum, or total copper; known_missing_information is empty but absence of spans for four named parameters means their applicability cannot be established from this packet. Because the burden for a closed ACCEPT (all parameters enumerated) or REJECT (none applicable) is not met, and four parameters lack any grounding, the correct disposition is UNRESOLVED. Partial per-parameter findings are noted here per the oracle relation contract; they do not support a single grounded non-UNRESOLVED disposition for the full obligation.
